# telnyx_requirements (Data Source)

The regulatory requirements for ordering phone numbers.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter_action` (String) Filters requirements to those applying to a specific action. One of `branded_calling`, `ordering`, `porting`.
- `filter_country_code` (String) Filters results to those applying to a 2-character (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) country code
- `filter_phone_number_type` (String) Filters results to those applying to a specific phone_number_type One of `local`, `mobile`, `multipurpose`, `national`, `shared_cost`, `toll_free`.
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.
- `sort` (List of String) Specifies the sort order for results. If you want to sort by a field in ascending order, include it as a sort parameter. If you want to sort in descending order, prepend a `-` in front of the field name.
- `version` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `requirements` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--requirements))

<a id="nestedatt--requirements"></a>
### Nested Schema for `requirements`

Read-Only:

- `action` (String) Indicates whether this requirement applies to branded_calling, ordering, porting, or both ordering and porting
- `country_code` (String) The 2-character (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) country code where this requirement applies
- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date-time indicating when the resource was created.
- `effective_end_at` (String) When this version was superseded. NULL means this is the active or pending version.
- `effective_start_at` (String) When this version became (or will become) active.
- `id` (String) Identifies the associated document
- `locality` (String) The locality where this requirement applies
- `phone_number_type` (String) Indicates the phone_number_type this requirement applies to. Leave blank if this requirement applies to all number_types.
- `record_type` (String) Identifies the type of the resource.
- `requirement_types` (Attributes List) Lists the requirement types necessary to fulfill this requirement (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--requirements--requirement_types))
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date-time indicating when the resource was last updated.
- `version` (Number) Version number. Increments with each new version. Defaults to 1.

- `id` (String) Identifies the associated document

- `record_type` (String) Identifies the type of the resource

### Nested Schema for `requirements.requirement_types.acceptance_criteria`

Read-Only:

- `acceptable_characters` (String) Specifies the allowed characters as a string

- `locality_limit` (String) Specifies geography-based acceptance criteria
